title: Local Convergence Analysis of ADMM for Nonconvex Composite Optimization
summary: In this paper, we study the local convergence of the standard ADMM scheme for a class of nonconvex composite optimization problems motivated by applications in signal processing and machine learning. The problems are constrained by a closed convex set, while their objective is the sum of a continuously differentiable, possibly nonconvex, smooth term and a polyhedral convex nonsmooth term composed with a linear mapping.
